recap:
BHA edges out Manchester City in a tense 2-1 victory.

BHA managed possession at 46% while pressing the opponent with a PPDA of 6.5, indicating a relatively tight press. The game plan mostly held, with possession meeting the target of 45%. However, the defensive line height drifted away from the target.

The turning point came early when BHA secured a high regain at minute 19, leading directly to a goal by #9 Harvey Radley (xG 0.26). Manchester City responded on the counter at minute 41, netting a goal via #9 Gabriel Voss (xG 0.35). BHA regained control through set pieces, securing the second goal at minute 63 when #5 Isaac Kane-Moss scored from a set piece (xG 0.37).
